<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919159_theRebbe_441" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919159_theRebbe_441__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the name Havayah represents both the simple foundations (above intellect) and the intellectual wisdoms, and the power that unites them is the essential name Havayah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">4)</t>
    <t s="2">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="3">that this is also what Havayah is the acronym for “foundation of foundations and pillar of wisdoms,”</t>
    <t s="4">for foundations and wisdoms are two opposite matters.</t>
    <t s="5">For foundations are the simple premises that are above construction,</t>
    <t s="6">above reasoning,</t>
    <t s="7">which are the foundations of comprehension,</t>
    <t s="8">while wisdoms are the intellectual reasonings that are grasped in the intellect, to the extent that they are subject to question and argument.</t>
    <t s="9">For in the service of man, the matter of foundations is simple faith that is above intellect,</t>
    <t s="10">and wisdoms are the matter of comprehension.</t>
    <t s="11">And it can be said that the root of foundations is in Havayah that is above worlds</t>
    <t s="12">(was, is, and will be as one),</t>
    <t s="13">and the root of wisdoms is in Havayah as the term “that brings into being,”</t>
    <t s="14">and the power that unites foundations and wisdoms,</t>
    <t s="15">that faith which is above intellect be drawn also into intellect,</t>
    <t s="16">is from the name Havayah, the essential name.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Dovid was punished for saying “Your statutes were songs to me,” because the essential aspect of Torah requires drawing down its intellectual aspects to reveal G‑dliness in the world, thereby revealing the essence of Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, it will be understood why Dovid was punished for saying “Your statutes were songs to me,”</t>
    <t s="1">for the Torah as it is from the aspect of the essential will that is above reason</t>
    <t s="2">(foundations)</t>
    <t s="3">is analogous to Havayah from the term “was, is, and will be as one,” which is above the world,</t>
    <t s="4">therefore,</t>
    <t s="5">the refinement from the aspect of this level is in a manner of rejection</t>
    <t s="6">(and not in a way of refinement),</t>
    <t s="7">“songs” from the term “to cut down the arrogant.”</t>
    <t s="8">And since the true matter of the unity of Havayah is that the unity is also from the aspect of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="9">therefore there must be the drawing down of the testimonies and judgments of the Torah</t>
    <t s="10">(wisdoms)</t>
    <t s="11">so that there will be a revelation of G‑dliness in the world.</t>
    <t s="12">And through this, the essence of Torah, which is above even statutes, is revealed,</t>
    <t s="13">the essential name.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that “Havayah is for me among my helpers” means that the sparks being refined, though a lower-to-higher process, are infused with the revelation of the name Havayah that is above the chain of descent, and this brings about the revelation of G‑dliness even in worldly matters.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">6)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is “Havayah is for me among my helpers,”</t>
    <t s="3">“my helpers” refers to the sparks that are being refined,</t>
    <t s="4">which are the true helpers of man</t>
    <t s="5">[and in the known manner63</t>
    <t s="6">regarding the matter of “for not on bread alone does man live, but on every utterance of the mouth of Havayah does man live,”64</t>
    <t s="7">for through man refining the sparks that are in the inanimate, vegetable, and animal,</t>
    <t s="8">additional strength is drawn to him in his service,</t>
    <t s="9">for the sparks help and assist him],</t>
    <t s="10">and the explanation of “Havayah is for me among my helpers” is that the sparks being refined</t>
    <t s="11">(my helpers),</t>
    <t s="12">even though the matter of refinements is from below upward</t>
    <t s="13">(a matter of the world),</t>
    <t s="14">there will be drawn into them the revelation of the name Havayah that is above the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="15">And the connection of these two matters is from Havayah, the essential name.</t>
    <t s="16">And this is also “and I will see [my vengeance] upon my enemies,”</t>
    <t s="17">for even those who are enemies of Dovid, who are enemies of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="18">one need not reject them entirely, but rather refine the sparks within them,</t>
    <t s="19">and by extracting the sparks from them, the evil within them is nullified.</t>
    <t s="20">And through this they come to seeing G‑dliness,</t>
    <t s="21">“I will see upon my enemies,”</t>
    <t s="22">a tangible vision of G‑dliness even in worldly matters.</t>
    <t s="23">And as it was with the master of the redemption,</t>
    <t s="24">that even the opponents,</t>
    <t s="25">even though they remained in their existence,</t>
    <t s="26">were compelled</t>
    <t s="27">(by the sparks within them)</t>
    <t s="28">to act according to the intention,</t>
    <t s="29">and there was a revelation of G‑dliness</t>
    <t s="30">(above nature)</t>
    <t s="31">in a tangible way</t>
    <t s="32">(within nature).</t>
    <t s="33">And through this he drew down the power for all who walk in his ways to draw down a revelation of G‑dliness that is above nature into nature,</t>
    <t s="34">and this became a close preparation for the completion of the intention of a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="35">that the lower realms will be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="36">for His very Essence,65</t>
    <t s="37">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="38">speedily, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
